newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lankans drinking more beer after duty reduction.
newsitem.headline: S.Lankans drinking more beer after duty reduction.

text.p: Sri Lankans are drinking more beer since the excise duty was slashed last November, but the government said it would not object since it wanted to discourage people from drinking hard liquor.
Consumption of beer had risen some 40 percent since the duty was reduced in last year's budget to 10 rupees per litre from 33.6 rupees, Deputy Finance Minister Gamini Peiris said.
"A bottle of beer is now within the reach of a wider section of the population," Peiris said in a written reply to a parliamentary question seen by Reuters on Tuesday.
The reduction of the excise duty on beer had reduced sales of hard liquor, but the minister said any loss in revenue had been recovered by an increase in duty on hard liquor.
"Nevertheless this exercise has been carried out to wean people away from hard liquor and the effect (of) the duty reduction is to be felt in the future," Peiris said.
